info.name: Lucknowi Lazeez Bhuna Murgh Biryani (Dum Chicken Biryani)(Mild Spicy)
info.description: Contains milk, gluten (wheat), soybean, tree nuts and sesame. Tender, boneless murgh and the longest-grain basmati rice, dum-pukht over hours with 23 shahi masale. This is Behrouz,s classic recipe - mildly spicy. The aroma of kewra water and the garnish of birista, almonds, coriander and whole spices add sheer nazaakat in every bite.

info.name: Chicken Tikka Kathi Roll
info.description: Contains milk, gluten (wheat), soybean and tree nuts. Succulent Chicken Tikka chunks embraced in a lachha paratha, enriched with the fusion of green chutney and mint mayo, and crowned with fresh, crunchy onions. A feast truly fit for the royalty!

info.description: Contains milk, egg, gluten (wheat), soybean and tree nuts. Spiced Murgh Seekh Kebab cradled in a lachha paratha, enriched with a fusion of green chutney and mint mayo, and crowned with crisp onions. A shahi creation, destined to leave the Shahenshah spellbound!

info.name: Mutton Kofta Kathi Roll
info.description: Contains milk, gluten (wheat), soybean and tree nuts. Delicately spiced mutton koftas wrapped in a lachha paratha layered with green chutney and mint mayo Finished with crunchy taaza onions a roll steeped in shahi indulgence

info.name: Paneer Tikka Kathi Roll
info.description: Contains milk, gluten (wheat), soybean and tree nuts. Spiced Paneer Tikka chunks cradled within a lachha paratha enriched with a layer of green chutney and mint mayo Topped with taaza onions this roll is truly worth savouring till the last bite

info.name: Hara Bhara Kebab Kathi Roll
info.description: Contains milk, gluten (wheat), soybean and tree nuts. Tender Hara Bhara Kebabs encased in a lachha paratha lavished with a blend of green chutney and mint mayo and crowned with crunchy onions A masterpiece fit for your daawat

info.name: Gosht Haleem (Mutton-Haleem)
info.description: Contains milk, gluten (wheat) and tree nuts. Tender gosht slow-cooked with lentils, barley, and 23 shahi masale, brought together into a rich, velvety blend. A soulful peshkash for Iftaar, to be savoured on its own or paired with your Royal Biryani.

info.name: Dum Gosht Biryani (Serves 2) with Mutton Haleem (660 Gm)
info.description: Signature boneless mutton biryani for two paired with creamy, slow-cooked mutton haleem for a grand royal feast.

info.name: Gosht Haleem (Mutton Haleem - 1200gms)
info.description: A hearty, creamy, porridge-like dish of slow-cooked tender mutton, infused with lentils, barley, and fragrant spices. Delight in this special peshkash as a main dish or alongside your favorite biryani.

info.name: Lazeez Bhuna Murgh Biryani (Serves 2) with Chicken Haleem (660 Gm)
info.description: Tender bhuna chicken biryani for two served with rich, slow-cooked chicken haleem for a feast worth sharing.
